issues.why: The word 'шилжилт' (transition) is unnatural for app navigation. 'Навигаци' is the standard technical term.
Redundant. 'eBarimt' is the official name and already means 'e-receipt', so adding 'цахим баримт' (e-receipt) is unnecessary.
Incorrect terminology. 'хуулга' means 'extract' or 'bank statement', while 'тайлан' is the correct term for 'financial statement' or 'report'.
The word 'бүртгэл' (registration/record) is less accurate for 'tracking' than 'хяналт' (monitoring/tracking).
The original phrasing is awkward and verbose. The fixed version is a more standard and concise way to say 'user groups with CSV import'.
The verb 'хийсэн' (did/made) is too informal for a CV. 'Хөгжүүлсэн' (developed) is the standard professional term. Added case ending for grammatical correctness.
